about: Magical things: rings, amulets, cloaks, staves and blades of power, robes, stones, and the wands, scrolls and deck that are used up. What each does while worn or wielded (modifiers, hooks) and when used; a dealer in rare things buys them all.

aegis_of_eternity.name: Aegis of Eternity
aegis_of_eternity.description: An indestructible shield that grants unparalleled protection.

aeon_stone.name: Aeon Stone
aeon_stone.description: A mystical stone that grants the bearer control over time itself.

amulet_of_focus.name: Amulet of Focus
amulet_of_focus.description: A powerful amulet that enhances the wearer's magical abilities.

amulet_of_health.name: Amulet of Health
amulet_of_health.description: A mystical amulet that bolsters the wearer's vitality.

amulet_of_protection.name: Amulet of Protection
amulet_of_protection.description: A protective amulet that increases the wearer's defenses.

angelmail.name: Angelmail
angelmail.description: A radiant suit of armor that provides divine protection to the wearer.

arcane_conduit.name: Arcane Conduit
arcane_conduit.description: A staff that amplifies the wielder's magical power to extraordinary levels.

ashwood_charm.name: Ashwood ward charm
ashwood_charm.description: A mortuary charm of ashwood and bronze wire, left on an offering tray. Whoever wears it turns aside harm and resists what would overcome them.

belt_of_giant_strength.name: Belt of Giant Strength
belt_of_giant_strength.description: A sturdy belt that enhances the wearer's physical strength.

bolt_blade.name: Bolt Blade
bolt_blade.description: A sleek blade that crackles with electrical energy, shocking enemies on hit.

bone_armor.name: Bone Armor
bone_armor.description: Armor crafted from the bones of ancient creatures, offering unique protection.

boots_of_swiftness.name: Boots of Swiftness
boots_of_swiftness.description: Lightweight boots that increase the wearer's agility.

censer_of_consecration.name: Censer of Consecration
censer_of_consecration.description: A holy censer that empowers divine magic.

cloak_of_invisibility.name: Cloak of Invisibility
cloak_of_invisibility.description: A magical cloak that renders the wearer invisible.

cloak_of_protection.name: Cloak of Protection
cloak_of_protection.description: A magical cloak that provides a small boost to the wearer's defenses.

crown_of_insight.name: Crown of Insight
crown_of_insight.description: An ornate crown that enhances the wearer's wisdom.

darkwood_staff.name: Darkwood Staff
darkwood_staff.description: A staff made from darkwood, enhancing the wielder's spellcasting abilities.

dragonhelm.name: Dragonhelm
dragonhelm.description: A helm forged from dragon scales, providing exceptional protection.

dun_rierdan_waystone.name: Dun Rìerdan Waystone
dun_rierdan_waystone.description: An ancient waystone that enhances the traveler's endurance and resilience. When in proximity it may point the way to Dun Rì, the city of seven towers.

unsupported.revealLocation: It points to Dun Rì, the City of Seven Towers (the canon's dun_ri); it will lead its bearer there once a world builds the city and names the place it is (seatOf(dun_ri, …)). No world does yet.

source.notes: Orsino's revealLocation: dun_ri. Dun Rìerdan is the City of Seven Towers, a metropolis of Imbar (the owner, 6 November); the waystone keeps that identity and function, not a generic finding-stone.

galvorn_mail.name: Galvorn Mail
galvorn_mail.description: A suit of mail armor made from the rare and nearly indestructible galvorn metal.

gloves_of_dexterity.name: Gloves of Dexterity
gloves_of_dexterity.description: Fine gloves that enhance the wearer's dexterity.

helm_of_intellect.name: Helm of Intellect
helm_of_intellect.description: A finely crafted helm that sharpens the wearer's mind.

helm_of_the_stars.name: Helm of the Stars
helm_of_the_stars.description: A mystical helm that enhances all senses of the wearer.

ironglass_dagger.name: Ironglass Dagger
ironglass_dagger.description: A dagger forged from rare ironglass, known for its sharpness and durability.

longsword_of_flames.name: Longsword of Flames
longsword_of_flames.description: A longsword engulfed in magical flames, dealing extra fire damage on hit.

source.notes: Orsino gives it no weapon kind or weight, so every weapon proficiency that names kinds excludes it; warriors (all weapons) can wield it.

mantle_of_charisma.name: Mantle of Charisma
mantle_of_charisma.description: An elegant mantle that enhances the wearer's charisma.

moonlight.name: Jar of moonlight
moonlight.description: A jar of cold, steady silver light. It shows shapes, not colours, and never goes out.

noonlight.name: Jar of noonlight
noonlight.description: A stoppered jar of thick old glass, full of the light of a summer noon. It does not flicker, and things that hate the day hate it.

old_glossary.name: Glossary of the old script
old_glossary.description: A fat book in wooden boards, in which brothers of a dead order wrote the old script's letters beside their own, and copied out whole inscriptions with what they meant. Carried and studied, it lets its reader make out the old script.

source.notes: Kyr's own. A book of reference, not magic: carried and studied, it meets a need of lore (the old script read) and helps at lore's checks; no training in lore (the owner, 7 November).

phoenix_talon.name: Phoenix Talon
phoenix_talon.description: A rare and powerful talon from a phoenix, imbued with fiery magic.

ring_of_major_protection.name: Ring of Major Protection
ring_of_major_protection.description: A powerful ring that provides significant protection to the wearer.

ring_of_minor_protection.name: Ring of Minor Protection
ring_of_minor_protection.description: A simple enchanted ring providing slight protection

ring_of_minor_strength.name: Ring of Minor Strength
ring_of_minor_strength.description: A simple enchanted ring providing slight strength boost

ring_of_perfect_turning.name: Ring of Perfect Turning
ring_of_perfect_turning.description: Grants high resistance to all damage types, and good chance to reflect spells back to caster.

unsupported.reflectSpellChance: Kyr does not execute this Orsino effect yet.

ring_of_protection.name: Ring of Protection
ring_of_protection.description: A magical ring that grants the wearer enhanced protection.

ring_of_regeneration.name: Ring of Regeneration
ring_of_regeneration.description: A mystical ring that slowly heals the wearer over time.

ring_of_spell_turning.name: Ring of Spell Turning
ring_of_spell_turning.description: Improve all resistances and inflict damage back to caster on spell saves.

unsupported.reflectSpellChance: Kyr does not execute this Orsino effect yet.
unsupported.onSaveVersusMagic: Kyr does not execute this Orsino effect yet.

ring_of_strength.name: Ring of Strength
ring_of_strength.description: A magical ring that enhances the wearer's physical strength.

ring_of_the_firmament.name: Ring of the Firmament
ring_of_the_firmament.description: A celestial ring that grants the wearer resistance to elemental damage.

ring_of_thorns.name: Ring of Thorns
ring_of_thorns.description: A magical ring that grants the wearer the ability to counterattack.

ring_of_true_sight.name: Ring of True Sight
ring_of_true_sight.description: A magical ring that allows the wearer to see through illusions and invisibility.

robe_of_elvenkind.name: Robe of Elvenkind
robe_of_elvenkind.description: A finely crafted robe imbued with a protective aura that enhances the wearer's agility.

robe_of_the_archmagi.name: Robe of the Archmagi
robe_of_the_archmagi.description: A legendary robe that enhances the wearer's magical prowess.

silvered_bracers.name: Silvered Bracers
silvered_bracers.description: A pair of bracers made of silver, offering minor protection against attacks.

singing_stone.name: Singing Stone
singing_stone.description: A mystical stone that emits a soothing melody when held.

staff_of_power.name: Staff of Power
staff_of_power.description: A legendary staff that channels immense magical energy.

staff_of_the_necromancer.name: Staff of the Necromancer
staff_of_the_necromancer.description: A dark staff that empowers necromantic magic.

sword_of_ages.name: Sword of Ages
sword_of_ages.description: An ancient sword of immense power.

sword_of_goblinkind.name: Sword of Goblinkind
sword_of_goblinkind.description: A mischievous sword that enhances the wielder's cunning and agility.

tirions_fury.name: Tirion's Fury
tirions_fury.description: A legendary sword imbued with the wrath of a fallen hero.

wardens_blade.name: Warden's blade
wardens_blade.description: A balanced mortuary blade carried by the wardens of the dead. It strikes harder than its weight suggests.

warding_focus.name: Foundry ward focus
warding_focus.description: A copper warding focus. A companion who knows how can raise a ward against fire with it.

source.notes: Kyr implement that grants the fire ward technique.

wardstone.name: Wardstone
wardstone.description: A mystical stone that provides a protective barrier to the bearer.

deck_of_multiplicity.name: Deck of Multiplicity
deck_of_multiplicity.description: A magical deck of cards with many uses.

unsupported.use: A summon aimed at enemy is not supported.

scroll_of_shapechange.name: Scroll of Shapechange
scroll_of_shapechange.description: A powerful scroll that allows the caster to transform into a fearsome dragon.

unsupported.use: It casts shapechange, which Kyr cannot run.

wand_of_polymorph.name: Wand of Polymorph
wand_of_polymorph.description: A slender wand that can transform a target into a different creature.

unsupported.use: It casts Polymorph Other, which Kyr cannot run.

wand_of_wonder.name: Wand of Wonder
wand_of_wonder.description: A whimsical wand that produces random magical effects when used.

unsupported.use: Kyr cannot use a random effect from an item.

scroll_of_apocalypse.name: Scroll of Apocalypse
scroll_of_apocalypse.description: An ancient scroll that unleashes catastrophic energy upon all enemies in the area.

scroll_of_cure_disease.name: Scroll of Cure Disease
scroll_of_cure_disease.description: A magical scroll that can cure a target of any disease afflicting them.

scroll_of_domination.name: Scroll of Domination
scroll_of_domination.description: A magical scroll that allows the caster to control the mind of a target creature.

scroll_of_fireball.name: Scroll of Fireball
scroll_of_fireball.description: A magical scroll that allows the caster to unleash a fiery explosion at a target location.

wand_of_cure_minor_wounds.name: Wand of Cure Minor Wounds
wand_of_cure_minor_wounds.description: A slender wand that can channel healing energy to mend minor wounds.

wand_of_magic_missile.name: Wand of Magic Missile
wand_of_magic_missile.description: A slender wand that can fire magical darts of force energy at a target.

wand_of_paralyzing_touch.name: Wand of Paralyzing Touch
wand_of_paralyzing_touch.description: A slender wand that can deliver a paralyzing touch to a target.
